entities.summary: Yordanis Borrero Lamouth is a male weightlifter from Cuba. He twice won a gold medal at the Pan American Games for his native Caribbean country. Borrero represented Cuba at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing, PR China and he won the bronze medal in the men's lightweight category (69 kg). Yordanis Borrero was a athletes & competitors from Havana (b. 1978-01-03, Havana). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
